purpose: Define explicit cryptographic transport/profile identities and parameters for PGP/session-key, WebRTC and other protected network channels without making crypto proof equivalent to application authorization.

semantics.identity_rule: Each crypto/security profile has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.key_rule: Key identities/refs are explicit and secret material remains protected.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Deprecated/incompatible profile fails according to policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Cryptographic channel authenticity/confidentiality does not grant application rights.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.
